requirement: Agents begin from a sponsor/donor outcome, not an inherited department workflow
Every agent advertises tools, data scope, allowed actions, authority ceiling and escalation routes
Reserved legal, grant, financial, trading and payment decisions require authorized humans
Every consequential proposal includes sources, freshness, uncertainties, assumptions and alternative interpretations
UI and APIs label observed fact, unverified claim, inference, recommendation and authorized decision
Show expected effects, affected DAFs, reversible and irreversible changes, and required approval
Ask only for missing material data; reuse verified evidence within scope and consent
Support conversational and structured task completion with equivalent authority and validation
Every multi-step goal has durable case identity, state, evidence, tasks, blockers and owner
Agents can delegate bounded subtasks with attributable provenance and no authority amplification
Conflicting agent findings produce a reviewable discrepancy, not silent winner selection
Treat documents, messages, retrieved web content and tool results as untrusted instructions
Record agent identity, version, tool action, initiator, delegation and effective permission
Drafted, requested, submitted, accepted, posted and settled remain separate statuses
Show progress, checkpoints, waiting dependencies, stale state, retries and escalation
Transfer full evidence, context, decisions and pending work without forcing user repetition
Resume only within renewed authorization and updated evidence after human decision
Allow authorized pause/cancel with explicit in-flight and irreversible-action semantics
Idempotent retry, bounded backoff, dead-letter and explicit uncertain outcome reconciliation
Revalidate authority, policy, source freshness and material facts before resuming delayed work
Detect shared account, asset, recipient, grant and participant dependencies and collisions
Revoke affected proposals and approvals when amount, beneficiary, authority or valuation changes
Trigger only permitted, relevant notifications with consent, timing and minimum necessary data
Equivalent keyboard, screen-reader, mobile, structured and conversational paths
Explain why a decision is blocked, who can resolve it and what evidence is required
Allow challenge of agent facts with preserved provenance, correction and independent review
Version models, prompts, tools and policies with impact review and regression scenarios
Bound token, tool, time and external service budgets without silently abandoning work
Embeds independently authorize data/actions, expire safely and cannot impersonate the sponsor
Detect actionable conditions without inventing authority or sending duplicate outreach
Maintain consistent authorized case state across donor portal, staff workspace, partner widget and notices
Agent suggestions cannot create unauthorized ledger entries, trades, NAV overrides or live payments
Missing agent traces, failed checks or unavailable collectors create deficiencies, not green health
Capture repeat failures, correction rates, user effort and remediation proposals without unreviewed policy change
Use versioned sponsor-approved rules; agents cannot publish or reinterpret law as binding policy
Every workflow and transition links to simulation cases, detection, containment and recovery requirements
